Container.Name: nexara
Container.Overview: Nexara is a self-hosted community platform for families, clubs and groups: calendar, events, posts, photos and chat. Requires the nexara-postgres container. Valkey is bundled in the image (REDIS_URL defaults to 127.0.0.1).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Nexara web interface (1-65535, default 8080).

Config.Name: Media Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for uploaded photos and files.

Config.Name: Cache (optional)
Config.Description: Optional cache directory (e.g. transcoding scratch space).

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Host is the nexara-postgres container name; user, password and database must match that template. Special characters in the password must be URL-encoded.

Config.Name: Redis/Valkey URL
Config.Description: Advanced: leave the default to use the bundled Valkey, or point to the nexara-valkey container (redis://nexara-valkey:6379).

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Use a long random string (e.g. output of: openssl rand -hex 32). Keep it private.
